Lore

[edit | edit source]

Hachiman, God of War and Honor, embodies the ideal of the righteous warrior, one who fights not for bloodshed, but for purpose. Born through divine will and raised in the shadow of conflict, he learned that war is inevitable, but how it is waged defines both victor and man. Temperate yet fearless, he meets battle with discipline and respect, honoring allies and enemies alike. Even as the gods descend into chaos, Hachiman stands resolute, determined to uphold his code in a world that threatens to abandon it. Those drawn to Hachiman value balance and precision, striking with measured force while supporting their allies and turning the tide through disciplined combat.

Basic Attack - Hachiman Basic Attack Notes:
  • Projectile stops on first target hit, and does not pass through walls
Fire a projectile that deals Physical Damage to the first enemy hit
  • Damage Scaling: 100% Strength + 20% Intelligence + 100% Attack Damage
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 0.48 meters
Ability Video


Passive - Master of Arms | Attack Speed Stacks Notes:
  • Each stack refreshes the duration
Hit enemies with your Attacks to gain a stack of Attack Speed and Mana Regen
  • Attack Speed Per Stack: 1% + 0.1% Per Level
  • Mana Regen Per Stack: 0.4 + 0.04 Per Level
  • Max Stats: 5
  • Buff Duration: 8 seconds
Ability Video


1st Ability - Eagle Eye | Empowered Long-Range Attacks Notes:
  • Long-range hits deal additional bonus damage based on your Basic Attack Damage
Replace your next 4 Attacks with empowered arrows that travel further and deal bonus Physical Damage based on your Basic Attack Damage. These Attacks can Critically Strike and trigger item effects
  • Damage: 10 | 25 | 40 | 55 | 70
  • Damage Scaling: 110% Basic Attack Damage
  • Long-Range Bonus Damage: 10%
  • Range: 12.8 meters
  • Cooldown: 12 | 11.5 | 11 | 10.5 | 10 seconds
  • Cost: 50 mana
Ability Video


2nd Ability - Heavenly Banner | Area Damage, Attack Speed Aura Notes:
  • The banner aura stacks with the Attack Speed granted on cast
Call down a sacred banner that deals Physical Damage to enemies in the area and grant you Attack Speed for a duration. Leave a banner that grants you and allies Attack Speed while nearby
  • Damage: 90 | 145 | 200 | 255 | 310
  • Damage Scaling: 70% Strength
  • Attack Speed: 10 | 12.5 | 15 | 17.5 | 20%
  • Buff Duration: 6 seconds
  • Banner Duration: 6 seconds
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 3.2 meters
  • Cooldown: 14 seconds
  • Cost: 60 | 65 | 70 | 75 | 80 mana
Ability Video


3rd Ability - Iaijutsu | Dash Then Stun Notes:
  • Parry grants 35 Plating against a single Attack
Dash forward, dealing Physical Damage and passing through enemies. At the end of the dash, swing your blade in a circle, dealing Physical Damage again. Enemy gods hit by both attacks are Stunned. Each enemy god hit with the sweep attack grants a stack of Parry
  • Dash Damage: 50 | 80 | 110 | 140 | 170
  • Dash Damage Scaling: 40% Strength
  • Swing Damage: 50 | 80 | 110 | 140 | 170
  • Swing Damage Scaling: 40% Strength
  • Stun Duration: 1 second
  • Max Stacks: 5 stacks
  • Buff Duration: 8 seconds
  • Range: 8.8 meters
  • Radius: 3.2 meters
  • Cooldown: 15 seconds
  • Cost: 70 | 75 | 80 | 85 | 90 mana
Ability Video


Ultimate - Mounted Archery | Mounted Charge, Fire Arrows Notes:
  • This is a channeled ability
  • Your Movement Speed affects charge speed; moving backward slows the charge
  • Can be cancelled early
  • You can ride your horse for up to 3 seconds
  • This ability can fire through walls only if you have vision on the enemy god
Leap onto your horse and charge forward. While mounted, you are CC Immune and can aim separately from your horse. Fire to launch an arrow at every enemy god in a cone, dealing Physical Damage and Slowing them
  • Damage: 225 | 280 | 335 | 390 | 445
  • Damage Scaling: 95% Strength
  • Slow: 20 | 25 | 30 | 35 | 40%
  • Slow Duration: 2 seconds
  • Range: 13.6 meters
  • Cone Angle: 45 degrees
  • Cooldown: 110 seconds
  • Cost: 50 mana

Aspect of the Steel Wind
Eagle Eye only has 1 charge but hitting an enemy allows you to dash to them and deliver a sweep attack. After arriving your Interact becomes a backward dash. Basic Attacks have falloff damage. +4% Base Health and Health scaling.
